method: round 33 sequence atlas, with a CONTINUOUS removal weight on the excess over it and ONE residual scale per eye for the whole shot; no mask
material_source: a generative video inpainter, pooled into ONE sequence-wide atlas so the fill is identical in every frame
catchlight_matte: tracked eyelid polygon AND the limbus, both feathered ~1 px
lash_guard_rule: no paint on or above the lash: per-column ceiling read from the SOURCE by walking down from lid skin to the first dark run that reaches legal-lash level, masked against the specular, its legal-black undershoot and the pupil. It can only ever REMOVE paint, so it cannot introduce a wrong-anchor artefact.
lid_shadow_model: 1 + A * exp(-depth_below_fitted_upper_lid / tau); ONE per eye for the shot, fitted on pooled observed-over-canonical ratios with each frame normalised by its own level beyond the reference depth, so only the part the per-frame scalar cannot represent is fitted
